diagnostics.title: Report missing routes, templates, services and translation keys

controllerChecks.title: Report route controllers without the named method and deprecated route settings

serviceChecks.title: Report deprecated service classes and service definition mistakes
serviceChecks.description: Deprecated service classes, duplicate parameters and unknown named arguments.

phpCallChecks.title: Report removed form type names, missing assets and domains in PHP
phpCallChecks.description: Removed form type names, missing assets and unknown translation domains in PHP code.

twigChecks.title: Report missing routes, assets and translation domains in Twig
twigChecks.description: Also reports route names compared with the current route that no route defines.

twigSyntaxChecks.title: Report deprecated for conditions and component syntax mistakes in Twig

yamlSyntaxChecks.title: Report syntax problems in YAML configuration files

commandChecks.title: Report console command return types and input mode mistakes
commandChecks.description: Invokable commands without an int return type and invalid console input modes.

deprecationChecks.title: Report deprecated Symfony APIs the project's version no longer supports

practiceChecks.title: Hint at Symfony best practices and removed form and Twig APIs
practiceChecks.description: Container access in controllers and constructors, request-scoped values in constructors, and removed form and Twig APIs.

publicDirectory.title: Public directory that asset() paths start from (project-relative)

compiledContainers.title: Extra compiled container XML files (project-relative, comma-separated)

extraServiceFiles.title: Extra service definition files outside config/
extraServiceFiles.description: Project-relative, comma-separated YAML or XML files.

extraRoutingFiles.title: Extra routing files outside config/
extraRoutingFiles.description: Project-relative, comma-separated YAML or XML files.

twigNamespaces.title: Extra Twig namespaces (legacy)
twigNamespaces.description: Legacy global Twig navigation hints: name=relative-directory pairs (prefer project Twig Namespace Paths command; not runtime configuration)

profilerIndexPath.title: Profiler index path
profilerIndexPath.description: Project-relative path of the profiler CSV index, read when you click Refresh in the Profiler tab. Empty uses var/cache/dev/profiler/index.csv.
